_comment: Complications. Each `.text` is a SEPARATE SENTENCE APPENDED to the event body, never interpolated into it — so it must read as a complete sentence after any body it can attach to, and must not depend on the body's subject or tense. Test one by reading it after three different bodies.
complication.queue_is_enormous.text: The queue goes back further than you can see, and it is not moving.
complication.queue_is_enormous.choice.bu: A quiet negotiation moves you up forty places. The people you passed watched the whole thing.
complication.shift_change.text: Whoever you were getting somewhere with has just gone off shift.
complication.shift_change.choice.start_a: Start again with the new one
You explain the whole thing a second time to somebody with no reason to believe the first version happened.
complication.you_are_running_late.text: Something you need to be on is boarding, and it will not wait.
complication.you_are_running_late.choice: You make it with nothing to spare, having left whatever this was entirely unresolved behind you.
You run, and you miss it anyway, and now you have neither the thing you left nor the thing you ran for.
complication.second_officer_watching.tex: A second officer is standing where he can see the counter, and he is not doing anything else.
complication.second_officer_watching.cho: Everything is done properly, at the speed doing things properly takes, and nobody has anything to write down.
complication.a_crowd_has_gathered.text: A crowd has collected, the way crowds do, and nobody in it is leaving.
complication.a_crowd_has_gathered.choice: You put six people between yourself and the problem and are out the far side before anyone has decided you were the point.
You get through, minus something from a pocket, and with rather more faces having registered you than went in.
complication.a_second_vehicle_pulls_in.t: A second vehicle pulls in behind you and nobody gets out of it.
complication.a_second_vehicle_pulls_in.c: You do nothing at all for two hours, extremely deliberately, until they get bored first.
complication.the_radio_is_describing_you: A radio somewhere is describing somebody, and the description is not general.
Collar up, head down, walking at exactly the speed of everybody else. Whoever they want, it is not the person they are looking at.
Trying not to look like the description is itself the description, and somebody works that out.
complication.it_starts_raining.text: It starts raining, hard, and there is nowhere obvious to stand.
complication.it_starts_raining.choice.sh: You stand under a canopy with four strangers for two hours, all of you watching the same rain.
complication.it_is_almost_dark.text: The light is going faster than you expected it to.
complication.it_is_almost_dark.choice.wa: You let it get properly dark first, which costs you the evening and makes everything afterwards easier.
complication.the_power_is_out.text: The power is out, and nothing anybody wants to check can be checked.
complication.the_power_is_out.choice.wai: It comes back on about an hour later, along with everybody's interest in doing their job.
complication.your_papers_are_wet.text: Your papers got wet at some point and the ink has done what ink does.
The explanation is boring and true and delivered without embarrassment, which is what gets it accepted.
It is not that they disbelieve you. It is that the page has to be legible and it is not.
complication.your_hands_are_shaking.text: Your hands are not steady, and you notice before anybody else does.
complication.your_hands_are_shaking.choi: You sit on a wall for ten minutes and eat nothing and feel considerably more like a person afterwards.
complication.nobody_here_speaks_your_lan: Nobody here shares a language with you, and nobody is going to.
Between the pointing and the drawing and one shared word, you get there. It takes a while and it works.
You both mime enthusiastically at cross purposes for ten minutes and part with mutual goodwill and no information.
complication.the_price_just_went_up.text: The number has changed since it was first said, and nobody is pretending otherwise.
complication.the_price_just_went_up.choi: You refuse on principle and walk, which is satisfying for about ninety seconds and expensive for considerably longer.
complication.they_want_local_currency.te: What you are carrying is not what they will take.
complication.they_want_local_currency.ch: You change it at a counter that knows you have no alternative, and are charged accordingly.
complication.someone_recognises_you.text: Somebody here knows your face, and is already crossing the room.
complication.someone_recognises_you.choi: Twenty minutes of where-have-you-been, and it is genuinely good to see them, which surprises you.
complication.another_traveller_in_the_sa: Somebody else here has exactly your problem and has noticed that you do.
Two people with the same story is harder to wave away than one, and you both get through on it.
Their problem turns out to be larger than yours was, and you are now standing next to it.
complication.your_companion_speaks_up.te: Your companion starts talking before you have decided whether to.
complication.your_companion_speaks_up.ch: They say four sentences you do not follow and the whole thing is over.
They say considerably more than four sentences, and some of them were about you.
complication.an_argument_ahead.text: There is an argument going on ahead of you and everyone is watching it.
complication.an_argument_ahead.choice.sl: You walk through the middle of it at a normal pace and nobody looks at you once.
One of them appeals to you for support, on a matter you know nothing about, loudly.
complication.there_are_dogs.text: There are dogs working the line, and they are working it properly.
complication.there_are_dogs.choice.get_i: You put it in the ditch forty metres back and walk on without turning round. Somebody will find it. Not today.
complication.your_bag_is_already_open.te: Your bag is open, and you did not open it.
complication.your_bag_is_already_open.ch: You go through everything twice before doing anything else. It is all there, and the hour is not.
complication.the_engine_is_still_running: You never switched the engine off, and it is still running.
You are in gear and gone before anybody has finished deciding whether to stop you.
Somebody follows for six or seven kilometres, close enough to be a fact and far enough to be deniable.
complication.the_road_ahead_is_closed.te: The road ahead is closed, and the sign does not say for how long.
complication.the_road_ahead_is_closed.ch: The detour adds five hours and two unmarked junctions, and you take the second one twice.
complication.you_have_been_here_before.t: You have stood in this exact spot before, and it went a particular way.
complication.you_have_been_here_before.c: You run the same play, in the same order, and it works the same way. There is a quiet pleasure in that.
complication.the_official_is_new.text: Whoever is handling this is new at it, and checking everything twice because of it.
Every page, twice, plus a supervisor consulted once. Four hours, and not one thing found.
